historic_survey.survey: Inner Mission North Context Statement, adopted 2004
historic_survey.eligible_district: Mission Reconstruction District; Inner Mission Commercial Corridor
historic_survey.note: Contributor to the Mission Reconstruction District locally significant area (3252-3254 16th St). Criterion C: the survey's proposed district for the northern Mission's rebuilding after the 1906 earthquake and fire, period of significance May 1906–1913, predominantly Classical Revival, Edwardian and Mission Revival in wood frame construction. Contributor to the Inner Mission Commercial Corridor locally significant area (3252-3254 16th). Formerly called the 16th Street Commercial Corridor. Criterion C: San Francisco's largest concentration of residential-over-commercial and small-scale commercial buildings, spanning both pre-1906 and post-disaster construction, dated c. 1870s–1931.

historical_record.description: One of the 98 residential buildings the survey counted as still standing in its Industrial Employment Study Area from the reconstruction of 1906–1909, the first wave of rebuilding after the earthquake and fire.
